original.derivation: Adapted the original PackageMgr source and retained applicable original comments, headings, authorship, copyright, and history through July 1985.

spans.boundary_evidence: The Ghidra symbol export names InitPack at 0x00416f90 and Secs2Date at 0x00417052. The final Pack15 BSR.S ends at that boundary.

changes.change: Replaced the later _StripAddress sequence with MOVE.L (A0),8(SP); MOVEM.L (SP)+,D0/A0; CLR.B (SP); RTS.
changes.evidence: ROM bytes 2f5000084cdf010142174e75 decode to this sequence. The original <C169> history says _StripAddress replaced CLR.B on September 23, 1986.

changes.change: Restored the Pack4, Pack5, Pack8, Pack9, Pack11, Pack13, and Pack15 labels and exports.
changes.evidence: The ROM has 16 consecutive BSR.S instructions targeting PackCom. The Ghidra export names all 16 entries. Original <C636>, <SM2>, and <SM3> comments describe the later renaming and relocation of these entries.
changes.confidence: exact byte match; names supported by Ghidra and source history

changes.change: Wrote explicit (PC) operands for InitPack, FPException, and Pack1.
changes.evidence: All four ROM LEA instructions that reference these code labels use PC-relative addressing. The original source leaves this addressing choice implicit.

changes.change: Replaced the StandardEqu.d load with the eight required equates and three named trap opcodes.
changes.evidence: Interfaces/AIncludes/ToolUtils.a defines MapFalse, MapTrue, ROMMapInsert, FPState, AppPacks, and App2Packs. Interfaces/AIncludes/SysErr.a defines DSFPErr and DSNoPackErr. Interfaces/AIncludes/Traps.a defines the three trap opcodes. The ROM encodes the same values.
changes.confidence: values verified against interfaces and ROM

changes.change: Removed post-1985 changes and EASE bookkeeping. Filled the header placeholders from the original authorship and title. Updated obsolete descriptions of InitMath, resource loading, stack layout, eight package entries, and the handle-table calculation. Marked the revised API summary as reconstruction commentary.
changes.evidence: The ROM initializes 16 package handles and uses ROMMapInsert with MapFalse or MapTrue. The function stack does not contain a saved resLoad value. GetPHand selects AppPacks or App2Packs.
changes.confidence: comments checked against the verified instructions

verification.method: Translate the source syntax, expand its macro definitions, assemble for the 68000, link at the ROM address, and compare every emitted byte.
limitations: Historical MPW assembly has not been tested.
The translator supports the constructs used by the current excerpts.
Byte equality does not establish the exact historical source text or prove completion of the ROM.
